_about: Everything setup.ps1 downloads that is not a Python package (those are in requirements-home.txt) and not a model owned by star.senses.setup (Kokoro, speech, llama.cpp, Qwen: pinned in star/voice/setup_models.py, star/senses/fastpath.py and star/senses/setup.py). Sizes and hashes were read from the publishers on 2026-10-26; nothing was downloaded to read them.

python.note: winget's manifest carries the installer SHA-256 and winget checks it

vbcable.note: No published hash exists; the check is the Authenticode signature of VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe (valid, and the signer name matches signer_pattern). The signer name is the publisher's as documented by VB-Audio and was NOT read from the file, because the file was not downloaded; if setup refuses a valid signature it prints the signer so the owner can decide.

ui-tars-2b.name: UI-TARS-2B-SFT Q4_K_M (Apache-2.0), small enough to sit beside the voice stack and a game

ui-tars-1.5-7b.name: UI-TARS-1.5-7B Q4_K_M (Apache-2.0), the accurate one: needs the card to itself
